verdict.rationale: Parsec offers a Teams API for automating deployment, so a sandbox or test environment for API work is a fair thing to ask about. However, the evidence never mentions a sandbox, test-mode API, or any environment isolated from production. The 14-day Teams trial is a pricing trial, not a sandbox that keeps tests away from production data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
